title: Novel AI-Based Algorithm for the Automated Computation of Coronal Parameters in Adolescent Idiopathic Scoliosis Patients: A Validation Study on 100 Preoperative Full Spine X-Rays
summary: An AI algorithm detected spinal structures and calculated coronal radiographic parameters in 100 preoperative adolescent idiopathic scoliosis images. Agreement with two physician raters was high for most measures (ICC 0.78–0.98), with weaker agreement for selected angles; this is retrospective measurement validation.
ai_technology: AI algorithm for spinal-structure detection and automated coronal radiographic measurement
organization: Schön Klinik Neustadt; Heidelberg University; RAYLYTIC GmbH; University Hospital Freiburg

evidence.tested: In 100 images, algorithm-human ICCs ranged 0.78–0.98; clavicle angle and coronal balance agreement were among the highest reported.
evidence.unknown: Retrospective, single-center image comparison against physician measurements; no prospective workflow or patient-outcome evaluation.
evidence.ai_role: The AI algorithm detects spinal anatomy and automatically calculates coronal parameters from full-spine X-rays.

source_review.scope: Primary full-text Methods and Results; source publication date and validation scope reviewed.
